Welcome to p! Archives
November 19, 2019
Poetry International ARCHIVES aims to give an overview of contemporary international poets and poems that matter, in the original language and English translation, with a special focus on Dutch poetry in translation.
We give you:
- a continually updated collection of poets, poems and articles curated by a dynamic team of country editors and guest contributors from around the world.
- the collected works of the annual Poetry International Festival Rotterdam (since 1970), updated with the new festival’s poet profiles, poems, translations, audio and video recordings.
Find your way:
Choose POETS to see freshly added poets and poems.
Choose FESTIVAL ARCHIVE to catch up on the exuberant 50th p! Festival or an earlier one.
Choose COUNTRIES to explore, for example, poetry from Iran’s underground Telegram network or find out about the newest UK Forward Prize winner.
Choose ARCHIVE TOUR to find poems on selected themes, such as the World Cup, the body, migration, politics and more.
Choose SEARCH to explore particular poets or topics.
Poetry International ACTIVITIES
See also: poetry.nl for all ACTIVITIES of Poetry International such as the FESTIVAL, the Poetry ACADEMY and YEARROUND activities.
